sourceQuote: public examination results in detail e.g. GCSE, HKCEE, HKALE, including in the case of GCE AL / AS level, the Statement of Results which shows the numerical scores achieved (optional) a summary of not more than two A4-size pages of your extra-curricular activities / personal achievements / working experience / any other information which you feel will help the selection committee in considering your application
targetQuote: 公开考试成绩详情，例如 GCSE、HKCEE、HKALE；如为 GCE AL／AS 水平考试，须包括显示所取得数值分数的 Results 声明（可选）一份不超过两页 A4 纸张的课外活动／个人成就／工作经历／任何其他有助于遴选委员会审议申请的信息汇总
